verdict.reason: The source says the DOR follows IRS rules on releasing taxpayer data and that aggregated results were released, but it never says the audit covers 34 data centers in aggregate only because of that. The $474.2M and $41.5M figures are not tied to it. $474.2M is the 2025 forgone revenue in Table A; $41.5M does not appear (2025 increased collections are $34.6M + $6.9M). The 34 data centers cover the DOR information used for the "but for" analysis, not the whole audit, which also draws on Aterio and other sources and uses estimates and projections.
